feature: Multi-provider panel: a report-only, configurable panel node at the design challenge or review step; the transport adapter (claude + pi); its own record and the run page's Panel section

scenarios.description: A run whose export carries the Appendix A panels record shows a Panel section on its run page: a report-only line saying it never changes the run's verdict; per panel a headline with the stage, the finding and accepted counts and the overlap threshold; the accepted findings each with severity, file:line, title, detail and the providers that raised it (an overlap badge when more than one); the not-accepted and unanchored findings folded below; each provider with its transport, model, status and cost (openai-codex shows subscription-covered, not a dollar amount). A pending run says the panel runs at its stage; a failed or timed-out panel shows its error; a provider that timed out or failed shows that state; a run with panels null has no section; the graph's panel node opens the same section; at 390 px no horizontal overflow

A challenge-stage panel renders its section on the challenge view as well as the run page. Candidate phase against the real API: a seeded run whose live panel.json is newer than its export shows the live record (source live) and a run without one shows the export's; worker phase: a mocked record moving from running to succeeded shows the new accepted counts within one poll without a reload (page.clock)
